name: Fiñana (Spain)
description: Yellow field with a red cross throughout fimbriated white and a narrower white cross along its centre, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Fiñana (a castle, letters F Y and a crescent on blue).
history: Fiñana was authorised by the Junta de Andalucía to adopt its symbols in October 2013.

features.role: cross throughout with white edges and a white centre line
Fiñana arms — castle, letters F Y and crescent
